# costory_enrichments_publish (Resource)

Publishes the enrichment drafts written by `costory_enrichment`: Costory compiles the live set with every draft applied, makes it live in one transaction, and starts the billing update. A set that does not compile is refused with the pipeline's error and nothing changes. Use one per organization. Destroying it publishes nothing; the enrichments stay live.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "costory_enrichment" "all" {
  for_each = fileset("${path.module}/enrichments", "*.yaml")

  name = trimsuffix(each.value, ".yaml")
  file = "${path.module}/enrichments/${each.value}"
}

# Publishes every draft in one transaction after the enrichments are written,
# and removes the enrichments whose file was deleted.
resource "costory_enrichments_publish" "this" {
  enrichments = { for enrichment in costory_enrichment.all : enrichment.name => enrichment.content_sha256 }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enrichments` (Map of String) Enrichment name to `content_sha256`, usually `{ for e in costory_enrichment.all : e.name => e.content_sha256 }`. Any change publishes. A name that leaves the map is removed before publishing, so its removal goes out in the same apply.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `enrichments`.
